title: Preservation of the memory relation
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $Z$ a size configuration, and let a light state $[0m\sigma$ and a word-RAM memory $m$ satisfy the stated relation at stack position $q$. If $1\le q$ and $a$ is a valid address, meaning $0\le a<Z.\mathrm{lim}.\mathrm{space}$, then for every integer $v$, updating the light state's memory at the natural-number address corresponding to $a$ with value $v$ and updating $m$ at address $a$ with the $W$-bit representation of $v$ again gives related states at position $q$.
hypotheses_covered: A size configuration $Z$ at word width $W$
A state and word-RAM memory related at stack position $q$
